ITEM.PTXT: By adopting a 8mm-pitch roller chain to drive the camshafts, the sprockets have been made smaller in diameter, making the engine more compact. Also, the chain pins have been chrome carburized to ensure wear resistance.
A hydraulic chain tensioner with a ratchet mechanism has been adopted to keep the tension applied to the chain constant. It is mounted externally for serviceability.
An oil jet (integrated with the cylinder block) has been provided to lubricate the timing chain, for quietness and durability.
An aluminum alloy timing chain cover has been adopted, which integrally seals the front of the cylinder block, crankcase and cylinder head.
A tooth skip prevention guide and chain guide are provided on the timing chain cover to prevent valve timing deviation during assembly and servicing.
The RH engine mounting bracket is a separate cast iron part, further reducing engine roll vibration.
